items.title: Google Confirms Exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day by ShinyHunters
items.description: Oracle has mitigated CVE-2026-35273, but it has not publicly confirmed the vulnerability’s in-the-wild exploitation. The post Google Confirms Exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day by ShinyHunters appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft Teams for Android Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Disclose Sensitive Data
items.description: Microsoft has disclosed a significant security vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android that could allow an authenticated attacker to expose sensitive information over a network. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-42835, was officially released on June 9, 2026, and has been rated Important in severity. items.title: Oracle PeopleSoft 0-Day RCE Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks by ShinyHunters
items.description: Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) have issued a critical warning after identifying an active compromise-and-extortion campaign targeting Oracle PeopleSoft infrastructure, attributed to the notorious threat actor UNC6240, also known as ShinyHunters.
